name: Patrick Schotanus
abstract_title: Consciousness and the Quest for New Economic Enlightenment
abstract: In 1994 the Journal of Consciousness Studies published its very first edition. Among others, it contained a contribution by the late Willis Harman, titled "The Scientific Exploration Of Consciousness: Towards An Adequate Epistemology". It was a summary paper of a retreat at Tomales Bay, California, December 3–6, 1992, at which fifteen scientists and philosophers attempted to explore the question of an appropriate epistemology for consciousness research. Other participants of that event included
field: Philosophy of mind, behavioral economics, consciousness
notable: Author of 'The Market Mind Hypothesis' (De Gruyter, 2023); founded Market Mind Foundation (2024)
notes: 30 years in investment management before consciousness research.
